release_notes:
Feature Release - Analysis Suite.

New Features:
  - Analysis Suite: New multi-log comparison tool (Data menu) for post-test analysis. Load multiple .xlsx/.csv test logs and overlay their parameters on shared, OpenGL-accelerated plots for lag-free pan and zoom.
  - Configurable Subplots: Assign parameters to subplots via inline dropdowns, mix multiple parameters per subplot (color = parameter, line style = log), and choose from preset grid layouts. Reorder, split, merge, and delete subplots from the sidebar toolbar.
  - Time Alignment: Per-log time offset (seconds) to align logs that started at different moments; toggle between elapsed (mm:ss) and wall-clock (HH:MM:SS) X-axis.
  - Cursors & Statistics: Vertical and horizontal cursors (per-subplot or all-subplots) with a live readout panel showing every log's value at the cursor, plus a Statistics panel that recomputes over the visible X window.
  - Custom Math Channels: Define derived channels from formulas over existing signals, including diff()/derivative() and integral()/cumsum() operators; channels persist across sessions.
  - X-Y Plotter: Scatter one parameter against another across logs, theme-aware.
  - Per-Subplot Normalize & Smooth: Min-max normalize curves to 0-1 and apply a configurable rolling-average window per subplot.
  - Export & Sessions: Export visible data as CSV, plots as image or PDF; save and reload full analysis sessions; Recent Logs menu; Import Schema Mapper for non-standard column headers.

Improvements:
  - Auto-Fit Y: Optional auto-rescaling of the Y axis to fit visible data while panning/zooming the X axis.
  - Theming: Analysis Suite and X-Y Plotter follow the active Light/Dark/System theme.

Documentation:
  - User manual and screenshots updated to cover the Analysis Suite workflow.
